about: Artane (benzhexol, also called trihexyphenidyl) 5 mg is supplied monthly from January to June 2026 beside levodopa, by brand name only.
Benzatropine 2 mg tablets are supplied five times from December 2025 to April 2026, in the middle of a 16-month history that also holds levodopa.
Levodopa with benserazide and rasagiline, the safer options the list suggests, are supplied. No anticholinergic antiparkinson medicine appears, so it must not flag.
